name: noesis
title: Tryambakam Noesis
description: Native Raycast console for Tryambakam Noesis: run Selemene readings, workflows, Daily Witness, and pulse insights with local history.
author: mage_narayan

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Selemene Engine API Key
preferences.description: Secure password preference for the Selemene Engine key. Preferred over legacy local storage.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Selemene Engine Base URL
preferences.description: Optional fallback API URL when onboarding has not stored one yet.

preferences.name: witnessUrl
preferences.title: Daily Witness API URL
preferences.description: Trusted Witness gateway URL used only when the execution route preference is set to Witness.

preferences.name: executionRoute
preferences.title: Execution Route
preferences.description: Choose where engine and workflow runs execute: directly against Selemene or through the Witness gateway.

preferences.name: readingHistoryLimit
preferences.title: Reading History Cache
preferences.description: Maximum number of reading rows to keep in the local SQLite cache.

preferences.name: cacheRawPayloads
preferences.title: Store Raw Payloads
preferences.label: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache
preferences.description: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache for debugging. When off, Raycast stores only minimized payloads.

preferences.name: pulseMode
preferences.title: Pulse Title Mode
preferences.description: Choose which current insight the menu bar title should prioritize.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Dashboard
commands.description: Command center for Tryambakam Noesis status, navigation, and recent activity

commands.name: engines
commands.title: Engines
commands.description: Browse Selemene Engine lenses with phase grouping and detail previews

commands.name: workflows
commands.title: Workflows
commands.description: Browse workflow chains with composition previews and cached reading context

commands.name: readings
commands.title: Readings
commands.description: Browse cached reading history with payload previews and detail views

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Profile
commands.description: Edit shared birth data, timezone, and reusable preferences for reading execution

commands.name: api-key
commands.title: API Key
commands.description: Connect, edit, or rotate the Selemene Engine API key and warm the local cache

commands.name: daily-witness
commands.title: Daily Witness
commands.description: Daily consciousness reading with somatic witness questions from the Daily Mirror engine

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Pulse
commands.description: Current TCM organ plus cached biorhythm and Vimshottari insight
